The fix is a one-line change: the cycle detection compared the number of emitted nodes against `len(graph)` (only the explicitly given nodes), but the topological sort operates over `deps`, which also includes nodes that appear only as dependencies. Comparing against `len(deps)` — the full node set — makes the check correct.
